_method_summary: MCA (Greenacre-adjusted) on the 8-axis atlas_frame_read_placement indicator matrix; per-move + garbage reads excluded; Procrustes-aligned (Decision 203). For this ARCHETYPE cut, (not-engaged) + rare values (<16 occ.) are set PASSIVE (speMCA-style), which surfaces the substantive contrasts the naive MCA buries. Re-run this script to regenerate.
